metadata.mechanism: Both finite trigonometric routes evaluate sampled cosine modes by a sine-product identity, isolate endpoint/alias cases, and use product-to-sum to reduce cosine-pair inner products to sum/difference modes. The midpoint grid and endpoint-weighted Lobatto grid realize different sampling functionals. This is an implementation/source-backed conceptual relation, not an equivalence or compiled transport.
metadata.hypothesis_map: Midpoint side: source d>=2, arbitrary integer k, d equally weighted half-shifted angles (i+1/2)pi/d with i=0,...,d-1. Spectral consumer additionally has kappa>=2 and1<=n<d, but those are not alias hypotheses. Lobatto implementation side: polynomial degree N=J-1>=1, nodes j*pi/N with j=0,...,N and weights1 at both endpoints and2 at interior nodes; the actually inspected C_index helper has k:Nat with0<=k<=2N. Its public momentum-weight consumer additionally uses J>=2 and h>0. No automatic identification N=d, angular grid, weights, natural/all-integer domain or step-size hypotheses is authorized.
metadata.key_estimate: Midpoint exact aliases: S_d(k)=d*(-1)^a for k=2ad, otherwise0, all a:Int. Lobatto bounded-frequency implementation: C_N(k*pi/N)=2N if k=0 or k=2N, otherwise0 for k:Nat<=2N. The normalizations are d and2N. Product-to-sum carries the exact factor2 on both sides, but endpoint weights and the midpoint half-shift change the alias sign and surviving-mode interpretation.
metadata.conclusion_map: Use one conceptual finite-harmonic-cancellation family to remember how weighted finite cosine evaluation feeds two real consumers: the actual midpoint reciprocal-grid alias series (C8 precursor) and the existing Lobatto cardinal/ordinary-Lebesgue momentum-weight construction (SPHMC B1/B2 precursor). A future common abstract sampling-functional lemma is a planned possible abstraction, not an existing Lean dependency. Both source-result completion boundaries remain unchanged.
metadata.failure_boundary: Replacing one sampling functional by the other fails already at the first alias: S_d(2d)/d=-1, whereas C_N(2N)/(2N)=+1. Omitting Lobatto endpoint corrections, the midpoint half shift, or the factors d/2N invalidates the map. The inspected Lobatto helper only covers bounded natural modes; all-integer extension is not claimed. The new alias does not prove Clenshaw-Curtis weight positivity or any SPHMC theorem, and the Lobatto positivity theorem does not give C8 Gaussian expectation identification/closed sums. Continuous circle averaging still loses aliases and finite r^(2d) corrections. No Poisson surface/circle transport, lower-bound, oracle/precision/TV/cost, foreign source audit, completion or purification upgrade follows.
